description: The chart illustrates negative log probability values for “Per-specialty terms” across six medical specialties, with multiple colored bars per specialty corresponding to different specialty term sets as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis contains the category labels Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics in that left-to-right order, and is labeled “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick labels shown from approximately −22 at the top down to −27 at the bottom in increments of 1. For each x-axis category there is a cluster of six narrow vertical bars in a light-to-dark palette (very light beige through darker brown) matching the legend labels Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics; the bars extend downward from near −22 to their respective values. In the Cardio cluster, the bars range roughly from about −25.7 to −26.7, with the light blue/gray “Mistralv0.2-Base” bar (shown separately in the legend) extending to about −26.7 and the darkest brown bar near about −26.1. In the Gastro cluster, bars fall around −23.8 to −24.8, with the light blue/gray bar near −24.8 and the darkest brown near about −24.2. In the Infect cluster, bars are shorter (closer to −22), roughly around −22.9 to −23.7, with the light blue/gray bar near −23.7 and the darkest brown near about −23.3. In the Neuro cluster, bars extend to approximately −24.2 to −25.4, with the light blue/gray bar near −25.4 and the darkest brown near about −24.7. In the Obstetrics cluster, bars are around −23.7 to −24.7, with the light blue/gray bar near −24.7 and the darkest brown near about −24.1. In the Pediatrics cluster, bars are around −23.5 to −24.7, with the light blue/gray bar near −24.7 and the darkest brown near about −24.0. The bars are grouped by specialty (side-by-side within each cluster), there is no stacking, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color coding and the separate legend entry for “Mistralv0.2-Base.”
